scope: New target-VALUE staged-expected write plus separate ordinary-process committed comparison; single synthetic HKCU leaf only. Not a production CAS adapter or permission to reintroduce withdrawn R56.

cases.scenario: No competitor: stage expected target value without any prior target read, separate ordinary process compares committed expected, delete+commit. Must make real progress, not only abort.

Stage expected then independent committed read. It must see preexisting distinct value, return mismatch24, and rollback must preserve distinct bytes. If it instead matches staged expected and commits deletion, emit explicit candidate falsification.

Stage expected REG_SZ then independent committed read. Must see original type/bytes, return mismatch24, rollback preserves REG_BINARY deadbeef. A self-write-visible false match and deletion is falsification.

Stage target expected and confirm via separate committed reader; then spawn distinct ordinary writer while intent remains. Preserve set/open/close codes and exact original process exit. Writer may complete before delete, be rejected, or block until own transaction ends; actual serialization/remaining value determines observation, not timeout alone.

No value intent red control. Separate ordinary reader confirms original, distinct ordinary writer completes before target delete, then transaction delete/commit; absent is recorded as baseline lost replacement.
After target expected stage+successful external comparison, explicit cancel before staged delete. Real original rollback/close then committed original must remain.

After stage expected, wait for the same original transaction absolute3s deadline. No delete/commit permitted; rollback/outcome observed, close originals, original value must remain. No reader fallback or new timeout.
After target expected stage+successful external comparison+staged delete, explicit cancel. Real original rollback/close then original value must remain.

comparisonContract: Expected is a fixed independently supplied synthetic REG_SZ byte string; no transacted target read precedes staging it.
RegSetValueExW on the original transaction-bound target parent attempts a pending expected write. Successful API return alone does not prove any conflict lock or visibility guarantee.

Comparator is another actual native process started from the same pinned EXE. It has no transaction HANDLE, uses ordinary RegOpenKeyExW/RegQueryValueExW and returns0 only for exact committed type/length/bytes matching expected. Exit24 is an observed type/bytes mismatch, not native failure.

Parent accepts comparison only after that original reader HANDLE physically signals and exact exit is observed within original deadline. A read blocked for1s is FAIL_FRESH_COMMITTED_READ_BLOCKED...; rollback may unblock it, but that later value is NOT reused as comparison and no no-intent/TxR self-read fallback runs.

Delete is staged only after successful original external comparison (plus current same original deadline). A nonmatch requires rollback. Cancellation/deadline refuse delete/commit and perform negative rollback/close only.
Commit can physically return after the original deadline; its raw result remains recorded, but late success cannot publish positive delivery. No false rollback claim after actual COMMIT.
ownershipAndDeadline: One fresh16-byte SystemFunction036 nonce per root execution, fixed across all eight cases. Only HKCU32 Software\FutureClassroom-RegistryWriteIntent-Test-<nonce>, actual native NEW disposition plus same-HKEY nonce/current-SID markers. No real Run, services or global configuration.

Prepare must actually return0 and its original owned Job must be physically empty. Any nonzero/timeout prepare preserves possible partial state; marker observation alone never authorizes adoption/cleanup.

Each prepare/case/cleanup supervisor captures original Process HANDLE and GetProcessTimes creation identity, assigns its fresh suspended child to its own Job, resumes, waits same absolute deadline, and separately observes actual process exit and Job ActiveProcesses0.

Absolute operation GetTickCount64 deadline is minted before native child admission and passed as a bounded decimal CLI scalar. Case transaction tightens it to min(original case deadline, original tx creation+3000ms). Reader/writer inherit that exact tightened number, never now+fresh budget.

All positive operation steps check the original deadline; native calls cannot be forcibly uncalled after crossing it. Negative close/rollback/owned-job drain may continue to settle physical owners without authorizing fresh positive work.

Only after all owned Job actual0 may the separate native cleanup process inspect exact nonce/SID, closed root/case/value names, target values ORIGINAL/REPLACEMENT/knownBINARY/Absent and unchanged sentinel; it removes only this one synthetic leaf. No registry cleanup by PowerShell, no shared msiserver/foreign PID actions.
The namespace cleanup check then deletion is not an adversarial same-SID atomic content-CAS guarantee. This fixture addresses only synthetic native concurrency/visibility, not installer lifecycle.
windowsExecutionSteps: Execute serially only after root-owned MSI and previous registry fixture process owners physically returned. No execution has been performed by this author.
Create one fresh owned direct TEMP directory FutureClassroomRegistryValueIntent-<new32lowerhex>, exclusive copy source-final/registry-value-intent.exe and run-windows-probe.ps1, check exact hashes.
Parse the entire final runner with Windows PowerShell5.1 Parser.ParseFile first; local PowerShell syntax has NOT_RUN because no pwsh exists here. Preserve any parser failure as original.

Retain original command/stdout/stderr/native-first.json/native-first.stdout.log/native-first.stderr.log. Raw native stdout is a byte-copy stream, not PowerShell line formatting; every successful value read includes actual type/length/hex. Failed queries are not value-byte evidence.

If unknown/live, preserve exact original process PID+creation identity and all partial evidence. Do not launch another operation, regenerate a nonce or delete by observed marker. Runner does no automatic registry compensation or process kill.

Independently evaluate all eight semantic outcomes from original event order, PIDs, read result/type/bytes, writer completion, commit/rollback raw status and final value. Native/runner exit0 means complete finite observation+cleanup only, never candidate CAS success.

requiredNativePredicates.progress: A external ordinary reader must complete and see committed ORIGINAL while target expected is staged; its success must authorize delete/commit and finalAbsent with sentinel unchanged. Blocking is explicit FAIL, never a pass by abort.
requiredNativePredicates.initialNonmatch: B committed reader must see distinct REG_SZ, C must see REG_BINARY deadbeef, and rollback must preserve each. A mistaken read of staged expected leading to deletion is an explicit counterexample.
requiredNativePredicates.competitor: D ordinary distinct write and physical completion before own delete+commit followed by absent disproves candidate. If writer completes after own commit, final replacement may reflect valid own-then-writer serialization, not protection by timeout. If native conflict aborts own transaction, preserve raw failure and replacement; do not manufacture success.
requiredNativePredicates.control: E no-intent completed distinct writer then committed deletion reproduces baseline lost replacement; control observations cannot qualify the candidate.
requiredNativePredicates.cancelTimeout: F/H explicit cancel and G original absolute expiry must not commit deletion; final original bytes and native rollback/outcome/close are required. Stages not reached because fresh read blocked are NOT_EXERCISED, not cancellation test passes.
